tagline: Corebridge Financial, Inc. is a leading provider of insurance and retirement solutions.
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted revenue is a key indicator of Corebridge's operating performance, excluding non-recurring or non-operational items to more faithfully reflect underlying revenue generation.

kpis.name: Adjusted revenues
kpis.explanation: Adjusted revenues that exclude net realized gains/losses, revenues from reinsured exited businesses, and revenues from non-operational litigation settlements.
kpis.description: Adjusted revenues are presented to provide better understanding of profitability drivers and operating results.
kpis.signal: Significant growth in adjusted revenues, indicating solid operating performance.

kpis.name: Total revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated by the company before any adjustments.
kpis.description: Represents gross revenue before deductions or adjustments.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in total revenues, masked by the increase in adjusted revenues.

kpis.name: Adjusted pre-tax operating income
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating income before taxes, excluding non-recurring or non-operational items.
kpis.description: Measures profitability of the company's core operations after adjustments.
kpis.signal: Decline in adjusted operating income, despite growth in adjusted revenues.

kpis.name: Adjusted after-tax operating income
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating income after taxes, reflecting net profitability after accounting for taxes.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's final profitability after taxes and adjustments.
kpis.signal: Adjusted net income slightly down, in line with the pre-tax income trend.

kpis.name: Total adjustments
kpis.explanation: Sum of all adjustments applied to bridge from GAAP to non-GAAP measures.
kpis.description: Represents the impact of items excluded from non-GAAP financial measures.
kpis.signal: Massive increase in adjustments, primarily driven by Fortitude Re-related items and exited businesses.

kpis.short: GAAP pre-tax income/loss available to common shareholders
kpis.name: GAAP pre-tax income/loss available to common shareholders
kpis.explanation: Pre-tax income or loss under GAAP, available to common shareholders.
kpis.description: Profitability indicator before taxes under generally accepted accounting principles.
kpis.signal: Significant pre-tax loss in 2025, contrasting with profits in prior years.

kpis.short: GAAP net income/loss available to common shareholders
kpis.name: GAAP net income/loss available to common shareholders
kpis.explanation: Net income or loss under GAAP, available to common shareholders.
kpis.description: Final net result of the company under accounting standards.
kpis.signal: Net loss in 2025, reflecting significant adjustments and exceptional items.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 413.55 billion euros in the last year.

kpis.short: Net investment income on Fortitude Re funds withheld assets
kpis.name: Net investment income on Fortitude Re funds withheld assets
kpis.explanation: Investment income generated by assets held in trust for Fortitude Re.
kpis.description: This income is excluded from APTOI as it relates to modified reinsurance agreements with Fortitude Re.
kpis.signal: Slight decrease in investment income on Fortitude Re withheld assets.

kpis.short: Net realized losses on Fortitude Re funds withheld embedded derivative
kpis.name: Net realized losses on Fortitude Re funds withheld embedded derivative
kpis.explanation: Realized losses on embedded derivative instruments related to withheld assets for Fortitude Re.
kpis.description: These embedded derivative losses are excluded from APTOI as they concern reinsurance agreements with Fortitude Re and do not reflect ongoing operations.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in losses on Fortitude Re-related derivatives, impacting GAAP results.

kpis.name: Businesses exited through reinsurance
kpis.explanation: Results from businesses that have been or will be economically ceded through reinsurance, including variable life insurance contracts with market-related benefits.
kpis.description: These results include MRB contracts and associated hedging derivatives, excluded from APTOI as they are not representative of ongoing operations.
kpis.signal: Reduction in losses related to reinsured exited businesses, indicating successful gradual exit.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies is present in the CRBG 10-K filing.
